summary_en: ONE CAREER Inc. raised its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal 2026 from 35 yen to 47 yen per share, increasing the dividend payout ratio target from 30% to 40%, citing strong business performance and improved financial capacity.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
ONE CAREER Inc. announced on November 12, 2026, that it has revised its dividend forecast for the current fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. The company increased its full-year dividend per share from the previously announced 35 yen to 47 yen, representing a 12-yen increase. Simultaneously, the company adjusted its dividend payout ratio target from 30% to 40%.

The company stated that it has positioned shareholder profit distribution as one of its key management priorities. While maintaining a basic policy of securing necessary internal reserves for future business expansion and financial strengthening, the company decided to raise the dividend based on strong business performance trends and an assessment of near-term capital requirements. The revision reflects the company's confidence in sustaining profitability while maintaining a healthy financial base.

The company indicated that it will continue to consider business performance and financial conditions when determining future dividend distributions to shareholders.
